entries.zh: 注意到；醒悟、留心（aduertir，兼 reparer 意）
entries.en: to notice, become aware; to take heed, reflect

entries.zh: 我已醒悟了；简要地留意
entries.en: I have realized / become aware; to take brief heed

entries.zh: 谄媚、奉承（同 lisonjear）
entries.en: to flatter, fawn upon; to coax with honeyed words

entries.zh: 煽惑、蛊惑（以谄媚欺哄人）
entries.en: to delude, beguile with flattery

entries.zh: 以花言巧语谄媚哄骗（〔口+扇〕）
entries.en: to flatter with sweet words in order to deceive
entries.notes: 汉字为口旁加扇的合体字，字义依词头 adular con palabras 推断

entries.zh: 阿谀、谄媚以骗人
entries.en: to flatter, fawn in order to deceive

entries.zh: 阿谀谄媚
entries.en: flattery, fawning speech

entries.zh: 谄：当面谄媚而背后毁谤
entries.en: to flatter a person and afterwards slander him behind his back

entries.zh: 谄谀：先谄媚奉承、随后毁谤
entries.en: to flatter and then murmur against; fawning followed by backbiting

entries.zh: 谄媚
entries.en: to flatter and then speak ill; flattering yet backbiting

entries.zh: 谄媚他（伊＝他/那人）
entries.en: to fawn upon him, flatter that person

entries.zh: 好口：嘴甜、会说好话；能言善谄
entries.en: smooth-tongued, glib of mouth; a flatterer with fair speech

entries.zh: 冷言：冷言讽语，皮里阳秋（反讽式的奉承）
entries.en: to flatter ironically, with cold or mocking words

entries.zh: 冷语：冷嘲之语、皮里阳秋
entries.en: ironical, sneering speech; cold words

entries.zh: 同人口：迎合他人心意与口味，曲意逢迎
entries.en: to humor another's inclinations and taste, to flatter by falling in with his wishes

entries.zh: 藏口：缄口不言人之过，掩饰短处以讨好
entries.en: to flatter by keeping silent about faults, to conceal another's failings

entries.zh: 悦人口腹：以酒食小惠笼络（谄媚之实）
entries.en: to please the mouth and belly, to curry favor with treats; flattery by indulgence
entries.notes: M 栏注 [mat peem.]（疑为 'mat peeng' 之残写）含义不明，释义依 L 词头 caricias 与汉字口腹推断

entries.zh: 路人：奸夫（Adultero；浪荡汉子）
entries.en: adulterer, lecherous man; vagabond
entries.notes: 汉字'路人'与 adultero 的对应依 M 音 loǔ xīn / R lū xīn 及马尼拉语境推断，uaron（bárbaro/浪子）义附后

entries.zh: 路头翁：奸夫（与有夫之妇私通者；'翁'＝汉）
entries.en: adulterer, the paramour of a married woman
entries.notes: R 栏仅记两音节（lū teû），M 栏为三音节 loǔ taū ang，展开依赖推断；词义由 L adultero 与'翁＝男子'推断

entries.zh: 失郎：与人私通的妇人、淫妇（失其夫之妇）
entries.en: adulteress, a woman who takes a lover
entries.notes: 汉字'失郎'字形与音 sît chiêr 的匹配不完全清晰，词义主要依 L adultera hembra 判定
